detail.dbDumpPathHelpText: Directory the database dump is written to before it gets pushed into the backup repository. A path starting with a slash is used as an absolute path, any other value is resolved against the shop directory. Leave empty to use the default path var/db/backup. databaseConnection.passwordSourceHelpText:
Stored encrypted: the password is stored encrypted in the database.
Environment variable: name of a variable starting with MUWA_DB_ (e.g. MUWA_DB_BACKUP_PASSWORD).

dumpOptions.description: Additional options for the database dump of this connection. Only these options are selectable. An option the installed mysqldump does not know makes the dump fail.

noTablespaces.label: --no-tablespaces
noTablespaces.helpText: Skip tablespace information. Required for MySQL 8.0.21 and newer when the user has no PROCESS privilege.

routines.label: --routines
routines.helpText: Also dump stored procedures and functions.

events.label: --events
events.helpText: Also dump scheduled events of the event scheduler.

setGtidPurgedOff.label: --set-gtid-purged=OFF
setGtidPurgedOff.helpText: For servers with GTID replication (e.g. AWS RDS, Google Cloud SQL): the dump can be restored without SUPER privilege. Not supported by the MariaDB mysqldump.

columnStatisticsOff.label: --column-statistics=0
columnStatisticsOff.helpText: Needed when mysqldump 8 dumps a MariaDB or MySQL 5.7 server. Not supported by the MariaDB mysqldump.

defaultCharacterSetUtf8mb4.label: --default-character-set=utf8mb4
defaultCharacterSetUtf8mb4.helpText: Force utf8mb4 as connection character set of the dump.

takeover.optionTakeoverDescription: Adds an existing local restic repository, including its snapshots, to the management.
takeover.hint: The repository stays where it is and is only read. The snapshots are taken over, you add the remaining configuration afterwards. Disable the previous batch or cron job so that two places do not back up to and clean up the same repository. Future retention rules (forget) also apply to the snapshots taken over.
takeover.restorePathHelpText: Target folder for restores. It must not overlap with the repository path or the dump path.
takeover.successMessage: {count} snapshots taken over. Please complete the configuration.

errors.MUWA_TAKEOVER_SAVE_FAILED: The repository could not be saved.
errors.MUWA_TAKEOVER_IMPORT_FAILED: The snapshots could not be taken over. Nothing was saved.
